label: Vantiva (formerly Technicolor) AFM0003 GPON SFP ONT
description: mini-GPON ONT in an SFP module (Realtek RTL9601CI, 32MB RAM / 128MB flash, Linux 2.6 (Luna SDK 1.9)) that presents to the host as 2.5G Ethernet; GPON line rate 2.488 Gbit/s down / 1.244 Gbit/s up on sc-apc with no LAN ports and no Wi-Fi, managed over web UI + telnet + serial.
